Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualified Chartered Accountant from ICAI OR Cost Accountant from ICAI OR full-time MBA (Finance) from recognized institution/university (working/retired from Central/State PSU)

content_sections.heading: Hotel Corporation of India Chief Financial Officer, HCI Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Hotel Corporation of India recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Hotel Corporation of India recruitment is Chief Financial Officer, HCI.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Financial Officer, HCI post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Chief Financial Officer, HCI post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Chief Financial Officer, HCI position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Chief Financial Officer, HCI position is Rs. 1,25,000/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Chartered Accountant (ICAI), Cost Accountant (ICMAI), or hold a full-time MBA (Finance) from a recognized institution/university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Chief Financial Officer, HCI post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief Financial Officer, HCI post is 62 years.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue for the walk-in interview is in New Delhi, Delhi, with pincode 110003.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.
